messages:
Maya Lopez: quick ping — PR #9123 blocked by an intermittent smoke failure on windows-gpu. can someone take a look? looks timing-related and is blocking a few merges.
CI Bot: build failed — job: smoke-windows-gpu (build/4822)
CI Bot: ```
ERROR: smoke_tests::alloc_heap_then_release
thread 'smoke_tests' panicked at 'assertion failed: buf.len() == expected', tests/smoke.rs:124:9
stack backtrace:
   0: std::panicking::begin_panic
   1: smoke_tests::alloc_heap_then_release
``` 
Samir Patel: thanks — can you paste the full job link and the failing commit? also does it reproduce locally for you?
Maya Lopez: https://ci.redwood.com/build/4822 — failing commit 7f2a3b9. reproduces locally ~1/12 runs for me.
Jen Ortiz: I can try to repro on my windows VM. which command do you use to run the smoke locally?
Maya Lopez: `RUST_BACKTRACE=1 cargo test --test smoke -- --nocapture alloc_heap_then_release`    (add `--seed 42` to make it deterministic sometimes)
Leo Nguyen: fwiw we've seen similar flakes from allocator races. try `RUST_TEST_THREADS=1` when reproducing.
Samir Patel: let's narrow the range — run bisect across commits 7f2a3b9..main with `git bisect run ./scripts/run-smoke.sh`. `run-smoke.sh` should exit nonzero on failure.
Maya Lopez: kicked the bisect locally, early results point to commit 7f2a3b9 touching kv eviction timing.
Samir Patel: cool — quick mitigation options: (1) xfail the test temporarily, (2) add a small wait-for-condition loop in test, (3) fix allocator race. prefer (2) as minimal and low-risk.
Maya Lopez: ok i'll open a tiny PR that adds a short wait and a comment referencing the flaky issue.
Maya Lopez: PR #9150 opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/9150 — tiny test change, adds `wait_until(|| cache.is_empty(), 200.ms())` before assertion.
oncall-bot: priority:high label applied to thread by @oncall
Jen Ortiz: i'll take a quick pass on #9150 now, assigning to me for review.
Jen Ortiz: quick note — the change looks fine, added one nit about timeout value. ran smoke 20x locally with RUST_TEST_THREADS=1 and didn't repro.
Samir Patel: thanks Jen. approving now.
Jen Ortiz: approved :white_check_mark:
Maya Lopez: merging after CI green — thanks everyone for quick eyes :rocket:
CI Bot: started rebuild of smoke-windows-gpu (build/4830)
CI Bot: build passed — smoke-windows-gpu (build/4830)
Maya Lopez: merged, closing the blocking PR. will follow up with a proper allocator fix in a follow-up issue.
Samir Patel: nice! adding an issue to track a proper fix.
